nodes.name: WO3 film deposition
nodes.procedure: Films of WO3 nanoparticles were deposited by drop casting catalyst ink onto glassy carbon disk electrodes (CH Instruments CHI 104, 3 mm diameter for nonhydrodynamic experiments, or SPI 4181GC-AB, 5 mm diameter for rotating disk electrode experiments). The ink was dried using an infrared heat lamp.

nodes.description: Cyclic voltammetry for HER onset and hydrogen intercalation in acidic electrolyte
nodes.source_text: representative cyclic voltammogram of WO3 nanoparticles recorded in 0.5M H2SO4 at a scan rate of 1mV/s. The reference electrode was Ag/AgCl, the counter electrode was graphite, and an Ar purge was used. The cathodic peaks in the CV are attributable to bulk H intercalation and correspond to (i) WO3/H0.250WO3, (ii) H0.250WO3/H0.500WO3, and (iii) H0.500WO3/H0.625WO3 redox couples. Intercalation is followed by the exponential onset of the HER at ∼ -0.4V vs SHE.

nodes.source_text: Chronopotentiometry measurements were performed using a rotating disk setup (Pine Research MSR)... rotated at 1600 rpm. An argon purge was used... Kinetic currents were extracted... using the Koutecky-Levich equation... The experimental Tafel slope begins near a value of 120 mV decade, but it exhibits a strong potential dependence, increasing significantly at potentials negative of -0.5V vs SHE... solution resistance ranged from 5 to 6Ω... adjusted to account for 100% of the iR drop.
